scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --reload"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND "npm --prefix frontend run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173" "backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m compileall -q backend\app
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests
